pages.title: Privacy policy
pages.body:
## Data we collect

The only personal data collected on this site is what you send us through the contact form (name, e-mail, company, message). It is used solely to answer your request and, if you ask for it, to send you the investor deck.

## Legal basis and retention

Processing is based on your consent and on our legitimate interest in answering you. Messages are kept for a maximum of three years after our last exchange.

## Your rights

Under the GDPR you may access, correct or delete your data at any time by writing to [info@y-stream.fr](mailto:info@y-stream.fr).

## No tracking

This site uses no analytics, advertising or social-media trackers. See the [cookie policy](/cookies/).

pages.title: Cookie policy
pages.body:
## Strictly necessary storage only

This site stores in your browser only what it needs to work: your language choice (EN/FR), the fact that you have dismissed this notice, and, if you watch it, nothing about the film. No cookie is used for advertising, analytics or profiling, and no data is shared with third parties.

## Managing it

You can delete this data at any time from your browser settings; the site will simply ask for your language again.
